title: 1846. Maximum Element After Decreasing and Rearranging

examples.explanation: We can satisfy the conditions by rearranging arr so it becomes [1,2,2,2,1]. The largest element in arr is 2.

One possible way to satisfy the conditions is by doing the following: 1. Rearrange arr so it becomes [1,100,1000]. 2. Decrease the value of the second element to 2. 3. Decrease the value of the third element to 3. Now arr = [1,2,3], which satisfies the conditions. The largest element in arr is 3.
The array already satisfies the conditions, and the largest element is 5.
